finalText:
Migration finished. 12 files converted, matching the existing `db.execute({ sql, params })` shape used by the already-migrated files:

- `packages/accounts/src/repo/session.js`, `admin/apiKeyAdmin.js`, `service/teamService.js`
- `packages/billing/src/repo/refund.js`, `service/couponService.js`
- `packages/catalog/src/repo/supplier.js`, `admin/variantAdmin.js`
- `packages/orders/src/repo/shipment.js`, `service/returnService.js`
- `packages/support/src/repo/sla.js`, `admin/macroAdmin.js`
- `packages/analytics/src/repo/cohort.js`

Verification: no `db.query` remains under `packages/` or `lib/`, and all 78 JS files pass `node --check`.

Two things I deliberately left alone:

- **`vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` (2 calls) — not migrated.** Its header says it's a vendored copy of legacy-orm 2.1.4, replaced wholesale on every upgrade with local edits silently lost. Editing it would be undone by the next upgrade, so the fix belongs upstream or in a wrapper. Worth noting `lib/db.js` says the driver's next major *drops* `query`, so this vendored dep will break then — you'll need a newer legacy-orm, a local patch step, or a shim that maps `query` onto `execute`. Happy to add the shim if you want the repo fully clean.
- **`cache.query(...)` calls** — a separate cache API, unrelated to the db deprecation; the previously-migrated files (e.g. `accounts/src/repo/user.js:18`) keep them too.
